correctness.rationale: For any two equally weighted values deviations are +/- (x-y)/2, hence population V=MAD^2. Direct exact rational evaluation of A=(10,20,30) yields (MAD,V)=(20/3,200/3), B=(14,15,31) yields (22/3,182/3); common mean 20 and strict reversed ranking. For centered triple (-a,-b,a+b), algebra yields MAD=2(a+b)/3 and V=(a+b)^2/2+(a-b)^2/6, and mean-padding preserves numerator sums. Claims are mathematically correct although prior-covered.
